refit_frequency: annual; the first target month of each year is predicted using data ending in the prior available month, and that fitted model predicts the remaining months of the year
training_objective: month-balanced stock-level squared error, matching the neural and Ridge comparisons
scope: Locked full-sample shallow boosted-tree mechanism validation. Hyperparameters are unchanged from the compute-only pilot; the full run tests whether adjustment cost and alignment benefit conclusions replicate outside linear and neural estimators.

pilot_evidence.resource_note: The pilot's peak_rss_gib label used a Linux divisor on macOS; the raw value corresponds to about 4.96 GiB. This full protocol corrects only that reporting function and leaves all scientific calculations unchanged.

promotion_gate: All input hashes, historical-only slices, complete calendar, finite predictions, archived row alignment, exact loss identities, and output checksums must pass. Interpret cross-model evidence only after decade-level and full-period A/B summaries are computed without changing this locked specification.
